Huli ang ilang mga sasakyang nakaparada sa maling lugar sa mga lansangan ng:

-Col. Boni Serrano Ave.
-Sen. Jose O. Vera St.
-N. Domingo
-Hemady St.
-Sct. Tobias
-Timog Ave.
-Quezon Ave.
-Visayas Ave.
-Congressional Ave.
-Mindanao Ave.

Siyamnapu't dalawa ang nahuli sa pamamagitan ng non-contact apprehension habang 11 naman sa physical apprehension.

data.text:
TRAFFIC ADVISORY: The Metro Manila Film Festival Parade of Stars will be happening on Friday, December 19 at 1:00 p.m and will pass through the heart of Makati.

MMFF Floats will be assembling on Macapagal Blvd in Pasay and will ply the city's thoroughfares including Buendia Avenue, Ayala Avenue, Makati Avenue, JP Rizal Street, and A. Reyes Avenue, and culminating at Circuit Makati.  

In partnership with the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA), Makati is the host city for this year's festival.  #MakatiTraffic

Inward Offin Canal from Apongbon underneath the bridge and descending CMS to Offin Canal is also good for now
